The '''Traval-Pacor system''', also known as the '''Traval-Parcor System''', lay in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Pacor sector/Legends|Pacor sector]]. By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], it was the site of the [[Traval-Parcor System Institute of Technology]], which was attended by the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Yansan]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to produce [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. [[12 ABY/Legends|Eight years]] later, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] triumphed over the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in a [[Battle of the Traval-Pacor system|battle]] fought within the system.

==Description==
The Traval-Pacor [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> also known as the Traval-Parcor System,<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> was located in the [[Pacor sector/Legends|Pacor sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was linked by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Baltizaar system/Legends|Baltizaar]], [[Corthenia system/Legends|Corthenia]], and [[Iridonia system/Legends|Iridonia systems]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==History==
The [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] former ecology student [[Yansan]] enrolled in the [[Traval-Parcor System Institute of Technology]]<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> at some point by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. According to ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'', [[Yansan]] graduated from the [[Traval-Parcor System Institute of Technology]] "about three and a half years ago," which translates to approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> Upon his graduation, Yansan went on to become an extremist [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

The Traval-Pacor system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], it was the site of a [[Battle of the Traval-Pacor system|confrontation]] between the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the New Republic, which resulted in a victory for the latter faction.<ref name="EGtW" />

==Locations==
The Traval-Pacor system housed the Traval-Parcor System Institute of Technology, which the extremist Yansan attended in order to learn all he could about technology and various devices.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Traval-Pacor system was the site of a civilian-operated Class II [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]. The output of the facility was limited to [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Traval-Pacor system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square K-7.<ref name="TEA" /> Although the system was referred to as the "Traval-Parcor System" in ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'',<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' introduced the name "Traval-Pacor system,"<ref name="TEA" /> which saw continued usage in later sources.<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="EGtW" />
